newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU seen valuing late-Nov French wheat at $159.83.
newsitem.headline: EU seen valuing late-Nov French wheat at $159.83.

text.p: A European Union award of 290,000 tonnes of free-market soft wheat at a maximum refund of 13.00 Ecus per tonne, reported by traders, values a tonne of late-November French wheat at $159.83 per tonne, Reuters calculates.
The figure, which should be regarded as an estimate only, is based on benchmark standard-quality French milling wheat at Rouen and may vary significantly for other EU origins and types.
The calculation uses the following assumptions gathered from market sources and Reuters data.
Implied fob price in dollars 159.83 dollars/tonne.
The same formula suggests an unsubsidised French fob price of $177.97 per tonne.
